video.title: You Don’t Need to Start a Business, Buy One of These 10 Instead

summary: Johnny Robinson (Johnny & Sergio, Home Service Academy) ranks 10 business types to buy from F to S tier using one test: would the business survive if the owner walked away tomorrow? Ecommerce/FBA, founder-brand businesses and first-timer franchises rank worst; laundromats mid; lawn care, fence/deck, pest control, waste routes and HVAC/plumbing rank higher; small ageing-owner cleaning companies rank S tier. The key takeaway is to buy sticky recurring customer lists from owners with no exit plan, using seller financing, then add systems. The video ends in a pitch for his Home Service Academy coaching, so the ranking is promotional.

speakers.name: Johnny Robinson
speakers.description: Co-host of Johnny & Sergio, founder of Home Service Academy (cleaning business coaching)

ideas.name: Buy a small local cleaning company (residential/commercial)
ideas.one_liner: Acquire an ageing owner's cleaning business cheaply via seller financing, then add booking systems, contractor cleaners and recurring-client marketing.
ideas.business_model: Recurring residential and commercial cleaning contracts; acquired via seller note/SBA loan
ideas.customer: Households, offices, gyms, medical suites, universities
ideas.problem: Owners are ageing out with no succession plan; businesses run on word of mouth with no systems
ideas.offer: Cleaning services backed by a bought customer list, run via a system rather than the owner

pricing.model: Purchase price typically 2-4x annual owner cash flow, low end or 1x or less for these

price_points.label: down payment on the author's own acquisition

pricing.notes: Seller financing, SBA loan ~10% down, sometimes zero down

acquisition_channels.details: Find deals locally, off-market: ask ageing owners respectfully what happens to the business when they want to slow down; deals not on BizBuySell or brokers

quote.text: the best deals you're going to find like the one I just told you about aren't going to be on places like BizBuySell or any public listing
quote.speaker: Johnny Robinson

acquisition_channels.details: Pound the pavement and get to know local owners

ideas.delivery: Cleaners kept as independent contractors rather than W-2 employees; online booking and dispatch system; recurring weekly/fortnightly/monthly client structure; owner runs it from a laptop
unit_economics_claims: Author acquired a cleaning business for $1,000 down plus a revenue share (30% then 15% then 10%) over 3 years; ~$250k/yr revenue
ideas.startup_cost: Low: potentially zero to ~10% down with seller financing; one example $1,000 down
ideas.time_to_first_revenue: Immediate, as the business has existing customers

acquisition.how: Finding off-market owners is relationship-driven; agents could build lists of local firms, but outreach to sole traders cannot be cold-messaged under PECR and deal negotiation is human

onboarding.how: Online booking forms, quotes and contractor onboarding can be mostly automated

delivery.how: Physical cleaning is done by people; agents can only schedule and dispatch

billing.how: Recurring card billing and invoicing by software

support.how: Agents handle rebooking and queries with human escalation for quality complaints

uk_applicability.notes: Cleaning firms and seller-financed deals exist in the UK; SBA is US-only (use UK bank/Start Up Loans), contractor vs employee status (IR35/worker status) is stricter in the UK, TUPE may apply to staff on acquisition.

risks: Owner may be the only scheduler/cleaner so business may not survive without them

quotes.text: You're not really going to buy a cleaning business. You're really looking at, "Hey, I can buy a loyal customer list."
quotes.speaker: Johnny Robinson

quotes.text: we paid him $1,000 down and every time we completed a service for one of his customers, we would pay him a percentage.
quotes.speaker: Johnny Robinson

ideas.name: Waste and recycling route
ideas.one_liner: Buy or start a local trash hauling route with prepaid recurring subscribers and high switching costs.
ideas.problem: Poor service from large (e.g. PE-owned) haulers

acquisition_channels.details: Spencer posted in neighbourhood Facebook group: if 200 people signed up and prepaid, he'd start the route; got ~150 in 10 days and $15,000

quote.text: he posted in his neighborhood Facebook group and said if 200 people signed up and prepaid, he'd start the route himself
quote.speaker: Johnny Robinson

ideas.delivery: Drivers run trucks on routes; owner need not drive
unit_economics_claims: Spencer ~$18k/month revenue at ~20% margin, ~40% if he drives himself
ideas.startup_cost: High: trucks and permits cost more up front than anything else on the list

acquisition.how: Community posts and local ads can be automated; permits and municipal contracts need humans

delivery.how: Trucks and drivers physically collect waste

support.how: Missed-pickup queries handled by agents with human dispatch

uk_applicability.notes: UK waste collection is largely council-run; commercial waste needs a waste carrier licence and domestic collection is statutory, so household subscription model is limited.

quotes.text: he had about 150 people signed up and $15,000 raised charging around 35 bucks per month per customer
quotes.speaker: Johnny Robinson

ideas.name: HVAC or plumbing company acquisition
ideas.one_liner: Buy a licensed HVAC/plumbing firm with maintenance contracts, run by a licensed manager technician.
ideas.business_model: Service calls plus annual maintenance contracts
ideas.problem: Urgent system failures where customers choose on speed not price

acquisition_channels.details: Acquisition competes with private equity buying firms with as little as $500k profit

ideas.delivery: Licensed technicians; need licensed manager or paper contractor with ownership stake

acquisition.how: Inbound search and local ads work well

uk_applicability.notes: Gas Safe registration is required for gas work in the UK; ownership can differ from licence holder; PE roll-ups also active.

quotes.text: these businesses are trading for 10 times, 12 times, 15 times profit. It's actually bonkers.
quotes.speaker: Johnny Robinson

ideas.name: Pest control route acquisition
ideas.one_liner: Buy a licensed pest control company with recurring contracts and sticky customers.

acquisition_channels.details: Established companies use door-to-door teams to land contracts

acquisition.how: Growth described as door-to-door; inbound search is possible

uk_applicability.notes: UK pest control is established; qualifications (RSPH) and biocide rules apply.

quotes.text: A homeowner will switch lawn guys over 20 bucks and they almost never will switch a pest control company
quotes.speaker: Johnny Robinson

ideas.name: Fence and deck installation business
ideas.one_liner: Buy a subcontractor-based fence/deck company for its referral engine and high-ticket jobs.

acquisition_channels.details: Connor built a website and put a couple thousand into Google Ads

unit_economics_claims: Fences: ~30% materials, 30% labour, ~45% margin before marketing; ceiling ~$1-2M
Decks ~50% gross margin; $60k project costs ~$30k; ~$230k owner take at $1M revenue

acquisition.how: Google Ads and website lead gen

uk_applicability.notes: Fencing and decking demand is similar; planning rules and prices differ.

risks: Feast or famine, no recurring revenue

quotes.text: Decks are the Rolex of construction jobs.
quotes.speaker: Johnny Robinson

ideas.name: Lawn care and landscaping company acquisition
ideas.one_liner: Buy an old word-of-mouth lawn firm and modernise it; sticky routes are the asset.
ideas.problem: Owners run on paper with no digital presence

pricing.notes: Can buy at what it earns today

acquisition_channels.details: Existing companies run on word of mouth for 15-30 years

unit_economics_claims: Connor's Landscape reportedly ~$10M/yr through five or six acquisitions

quotes.text: Customer relationships and the routes that these companies have built up are the real asset
quotes.speaker: Johnny Robinson

ideas.name: Laundromat acquisition
ideas.one_liner: Buy a laundromat; widely hyped, thin margins, crowded bidding.

pricing.notes: Priced 2-4x owner cash flow, often at high end

ideas.name: Franchise purchase
ideas.one_liner: Buying into franchises: ranked D tier for first-timers.
risks: Brand adds no moat in local services

quotes.text: you're kind of just leasing the right to operate somebody else's playbook
quotes.speaker: Johnny Robinson

ideas.name: Founder-brand business acquisition (coaching, courses, boutique agency)
ideas.one_liner: Buying a personal-brand business is warned against.

ideas.name: Ecommerce / Amazon FBA brand acquisition
ideas.one_liner: Buying marketplace-dependent brands: F tier due to platform risk.

quotes.text: You're paying today's price for tomorrow's uncertainty.
quotes.speaker: Johnny Robinson

quote.text: today, he's just under $18,000 a month in revenue at around a 20% margin
quote.speaker: Johnny Robinson

tactics.name: Off-market owner outreach
steps: Identify local firms run by ageing owners
Ask respectfully what happens to the business when they want to slow down
Get real owner cash flow numbers

quote.text: Have you thought about what happens to this business when you're ready to slow down?
quote.speaker: Johnny Robinson

tactics.name: Structure deal to self-fund
steps: Seller note paid from revenue share

tactics.name: Prepaid neighbourhood demand test
steps: Ask for prepaid sign-ups at a threshold

warnings.warning: Buying a founder-brand business means the audience's trust doesn't transfer

quote.text: And when a business is built entirely around one irreplaceable person, that just isn't a business.
quote.speaker: Johnny Robinson

warnings.warning: Franchise buyer lost his 401k after being sold the dream
Get real owner cash flow, not gross, before pricing

lessons.lesson: Test any acquisition by asking whether it survives if the owner leaves.

quote.text: Would this business survive if the current owner walked away tomorrow?
quote.speaker: Johnny Robinson

lessons.lesson: Platform-dependent revenue is rented, not owned.
Sticky recurring revenue with barriers to entry is the best acquisition target.
Seller financing lets the business pay for itself.
Unsystemised businesses are upside, as improvements are bought at a discount.
Get operating skills before taking on debt service.

evidence_quality.rationale: Ranking is opinion-based with second-hand figures; only the cleaning acquisition is first-hand and unverified.
evidence_quality.promotional_conflict: Host sells Home Service Academy cleaning-business coaching and ranks cleaning S tier.
